svg.title: From Signed Merchant to Audited Residual
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-retained-residual-workflow; chart type: process_flow; title: From Signed Merchant to Audited Residual; subtitle: Five operating stages separate payment volume from operator earnings.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: The revenue basis is retained ISO residuals, gateway markups, and ATM surcharge shares. Merchant settlement funds and ATM vault cash are excluded. ASC 606 principal-versus-agent assessment follows the actual contracts; this model uses the specified retained basis.; caption: Own the contract, verify the boarding decision, and reconcile the retained payment before treating an account as productive.; stages: label: Source and qualify; value: Verify merchant and venue fit; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Capture merchant category, ownership, statements, refund patterns, venue traffic, and placement rights in IRIS CRM; reject prohibited activity before quoting.; label: Price the retained spread; value: Model Schedule A and venue shares; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Calculate residuals after processor deductions and ATM venue shares; document gateway markup, minimums, clawbacks, reserve exposure, and residual assignment rights.; label: Submit transparent underwriting; value: Sponsor decides acceptance and reserves; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Submit accurate ownership, merchant category, websites, fulfillment terms, and processing history. Never split transactions across MIDs to conceal risk or thresholds.; label: Activate and monitor; value: Test pricing, disclosures, and telemetry; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Test debit exclusions and credit-price presentation; configure supported Verifi RDR or Ethoca workflows, ATM fee election, remote telemetry, and vault-cash alerts.; label: Audit and retain; value: Tie statements to bank receipts; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Reconcile IRIS CRM residual imports against Schedule A and sponsor statements; investigate missing MIDs, rate compression, surcharge deductions, attrition, and cash variances.

text.title: From Signed Merchant to Audited Residual
text.tspan: From Signed Merchant to Audited Residual

circle.title: label: Source and qualify; value: Verify merchant and venue fit; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Capture merchant category, ownership, statements, refund patterns, venue traffic, and placement rights in IRIS CRM; reject prohibited activity before quoting.

text.title: Capture merchant category, ownership, statements, refund patterns, venue traffic, and placement rights in IRIS CRM; reject prohibited activity before quoting.

circle.title: label: Price the retained spread; value: Model Schedule A and venue shares; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Calculate residuals after processor deductions and ATM venue shares; document gateway markup, minimums, clawbacks, reserve exposure, and residual assignment rights.

text.title: Calculate residuals after processor deductions and ATM venue shares; document gateway markup, minimums, clawbacks, reserve exposure, and residual assignment rights.

circle.title: label: Submit transparent underwriting; value: Sponsor decides acceptance and reserves; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Submit accurate ownership, merchant category, websites, fulfillment terms, and processing history. Never split transactions across MIDs to conceal risk or thresholds.

text.title: Submit accurate ownership, merchant category, websites, fulfillment terms, and processing history. Never split transactions across MIDs to conceal risk or thresholds.

circle.title: label: Activate and monitor; value: Test pricing, disclosures, and telemetry; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Test debit exclusions and credit-price presentation; configure supported Verifi RDR or Ethoca workflows, ATM fee election, remote telemetry, and vault-cash alerts.

text.title: Test debit exclusions and credit-price presentation; configure supported Verifi RDR or Ethoca workflows, ATM fee election, remote telemetry, and vault-cash alerts.

circle.title: label: Audit and retain; value: Tie statements to bank receipts; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Reconcile IRIS CRM residual imports against Schedule A and sponsor statements; investigate missing MIDs, rate compression, surcharge deductions, attrition, and cash variances.

text.title: Reconcile IRIS CRM residual imports against Schedule A and sponsor statements; investigate missing MIDs, rate compression, surcharge deductions, attrition, and cash variances.

Assumptions: The revenue basis is retained ISO residuals, gateway markups, and ATM surcharge shares. Merchant settlement funds and ATM vault cash are excluded. ASC 606 principal-versus-agent assessment follows the actual contracts; this model uses the specified retained basis.
